text:
carmen: Quick sync notes from SensorWave integration call. They send aggregated gateway reports (one gateway may bundle 50 sensors) and sometimes replay old aggregates after reconnect. We need clear rules for attribution (per-sensor vs gateway), proration for partial-day connectivity, and dedupe.

devin: Do they include per-sensor IDs in the payload or only gateway totals?

carmen: They include an array of sensors but sometimes omit IDs for older devices and just send gateway_total_secs. Example payloads:
```json
{"gateway_id":"gw-77","account_id":"acct-42","reported_at":"2026-03-19T23:50:00Z","gateway_total_secs":36000,"sensors":[{"sensor_id":"s-1","secs":1200},{"sensor_id":"s-2","secs":4800}],"signature":"hmac:..."}

{"gateway_id":"gw-77","account_id":"acct-42","reported_at":"2026-03-21T02:10:00Z","gateway_total_secs":90000}
```

padma: Finance requirement: billing must be deterministic and map to SKU=sensor-hour. If gateway-only reports arrive, they want us to either reject with contract error, or run a deterministic split algorithm to attribute to sensors. Which is acceptable?

devin: Implementation options:
- Strict schema: reject gateway-only reports and ask partner to resend expanded payload (fastest to be correct).
- Heuristic split: when sensor list omitted, divide gateway_total_secs proportionally based on latest known per-sensor weights (fall back to equal split). Markged as heuristically-attributed and flagged for reconciliation.

rupert: Operationally, heuristics will create thorny reconcile work. If we accept heuristics we need strong observability: tag heuristically-attributed records, and surface in Console + daily reconcile report.

carmen: Also edge-case: gateway replays an older cumulative total after a reset, causing negative delta. Need handling: if incoming.gateway_total_secs < last.gateway_total_secs and reset_flag not present => hold for recon. If reset_flag present or monotonic_seq wraps => treat as reset.

devin: Proposed ingest algorithm (compact):
```
last = db.get(gateway_id).last_total_secs
if incoming.signature invalid: reject 401
if incoming.event_id in db.seen: return // idempotent
if incoming.gateway_total_secs >= last:
  delta = incoming.gateway_total_secs - last
  if sensors array present:
    allocate per sensor from payload
  else:
    allocate via last_known_weights or equal split, tag as heuristic
elif incoming.reset_flag:
  delta = incoming.gateway_total_secs // treat as fresh
else:
  enqueue_recon(incoming)
record_usage(account_id, sku:sensor-hour, allocations, reported_at)
update db.last_total_secs
```

padma: For accounting and marketplace reports we also need a nightly reconciliation that:
- flags heuristic allocations > 10% of account_monthly_usage
- attempts auto-correction when partner supplies later expanded payloads within 14 days
- produces a CSV for finance with original vs reconciled rows and rationale

rupert: Alerts: create alert when unexplained negative deltas >0.2% of gateways in a region for 6h. Also track percent heuristic-attrib per account; if >5% for 7 days, drive partner remediation.

carmen: Action items: @devin add schema validation + heuristic split code + PR, include test vectors (gateway-only, mixed, replay, reset). @rupert implement recon job + alerts + Console flags. @padma define CSV columns and threshold tolerances for finance. I'll update SensorWave contract to prefer expanded sensor array and include event_id, reset_flag, monotonic_seq, device_tz, and signed_hmac.

devin: ETA? Can do schema + ingest changes in 10 days, canary 1 week, then enable heuristic mode behind feature flag.

padma: Finance needs the CSV and reconciliation run in place before we accept any gateway-only data into billing. So keep gateway-only in hold mode until recon pipeline exists.

carmen: Agreed. I'll tell SensorWave we'll accept gateway-only reports only in testing mode; production requires sensor-level detail or signed agreement on heuristic attribution. Posting notes + sample payloads to partner thread.

marketplace-bot: infra-bot: Recon job created ticket https://issues.redwood/PRJ-889 and schema PR https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1248
